Once upon a time, there was a big boat near the river. The boat had a long, black and white sail on the coral island. One day, a bad storm came and destroyed the boat. The boat could not go anywhere and they felt sad.

A little girl named Lily saw her boat and asked, "Why are you sad?"

The boat replied, "I lost my boat and I can't find it."

Lily said, "Don't worry, little boat. I have an idea. Let's search together."
